description: Implementation of the BatteryService class for Android, managing sensor activation, deactivation, and wakeup events, interfacing with battery statistics service.

classes.name: BatteryService
classes.description: Manages battery-related sensor activities and communicates with battery statistics service.

methods.name: addSensor
methods.description: Adds a sensor activation record for a given UID and handle.

methods.name: removeSensor
methods.description: Removes a sensor activation record for a given UID and handle.

methods.name: enableSensorImpl
methods.description: Enables a sensor, notifying the battery stats service.

methods.name: disableSensorImpl
methods.description: Disables a sensor, notifying the battery stats service.

methods.name: noteWakeupSensorEventImpl
methods.description: Records a wakeup sensor event with elapsed time.

methods.name: checkService
methods.description: Checks and initializes the battery stats service interface.
